description: This file defines the interface for an IniFile class used to manage INI configuration files, including methods to load, clear, retrieve, set, and flush configuration entries. It also includes conditional compilation for unit testing support.

classes.name: IniFile
classes.description: A class providing an interface to load, manipulate, and save INI file data, encapsulating filename and key-value mappings.

methods.name: IniFile
methods.description: Constructor for initializing an IniFile object.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads key-value pairs from a specified INI file.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, with an optional default value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Assigns a value to a specific key.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Persists any changes to the INI file, if applicable.
